name: Facet
text: Use a dark theme with a high-contrast accent color (electric blue) for key interactive elements in EXCAVA’s interface. This maximizes visibility and liveliness in low-light screencasts, making clicks and selections pop against dark backgrounds. The trade-off is that some users may prefer a light theme for readability in bright environments, but screencast clarity wins for shared visibility.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Dark themes with high-contrast accents still fail users with astigmatism or light sensitivity—electric blue bleeds into grays for them. A slate-blue light theme with dark text and subtle slate accents keeps key elements distinct without sacrificing readability for the majority. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time and error rates for both themes with a 10-person sample.
